{{Quote|Red... Red blade, going after you, made me tell... The ''Ghost'' is in danger.|The crewman to Ezra and Kanan|<ref name="THOF" />}}
A '''rebel trooper''' was on a [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvette]] belonging to [[Phoenix Cell]] when it was attacked by [[Maul]], a former [[Sith Lord]]. When [[Ezra Bridger]] and [[Kanan Jarrus]] later boarded his vessel to investigate, he told them that there was a "[[Color|red]] blade" looking for them, and that the [[starship]] ''[[Ghost]]'' was in danger.<ref name="THOF" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This rebel trooper first appeared in "[[The Holocrons of Fate]]" and was voiced by [[Steve Blum]], who also voiced [[Garazeb Orrelios]], [[Alton Kastle]], and many others in the series.
